age.evidence: Nine Sprague-Dawley rats (8 females, 1 male, 6-12 months old; Taconic, Denmark)

sex.evidence: Nine Sprague-Dawley rats (8 females, 1 male, 6-12 months old)

dosing.evidence: intraperitoneally injected with LSD (lysergic acid diethylamid, 0.3 mg/kg, Lipomed AG, Switzerland)
DOI (2,5-dimethoxy-4-iodoamphetamine hydrochloride, 2 mg/kg, Lipomed AG, Switzerland)
PCP (phencyclidine hydrochloride, 5 mg/kg, Lipomed AG, Switzerland)

group_housing.evidence: Animals were kept in plastic cages on a 12:12-h light-dark cycle

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12-h light-dark cycle (lights on from 5:30 h to 17:30 h)

assays.assay_name: Open Field Test with multi-behavior scoring
assays.assay_description: Freely behaving rats placed in a round open field arena. 60 min baseline + 60-120 min post-drug recording. Video tracking measured distance, speed, time in center; manual video scoring of 12 behaviors (grooming, rearing, sniffing up/down, head-swaying, moving backwards, intermittent turning, unstableness, falling over, lying down, crawling, being still); accelerometer-based head-twitch detection. Composite ataxia and stereotypy scores derived.

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneally injected with LSD, DOI, ketamine, PCP or amphetamine

setup_habituation.evidence: not described; the 60 min baseline served as recording, not pre-test apparatus habituation

setup_restrain.evidence: freely behaving rats placed in a round open field arena

food_restriction.evidence: Animals placed in round open field arena for recording; no food in apparatus described

water_restriction.evidence: Animals placed in round open field arena for recording; no water in apparatus described

time_to_assay.evidence: After ~60 min of baseline recording, the animal was intraperitoneally injected... and recorded for another 60-120 minutes. Data were averaged over... 30 to 60 minutes for on-drug measurements

sample_size.evidence: Nine Sprague-Dawley rats... in total 18 LSD, 9 DOI, 27 ketamine, 7 PCP, and 10 amphetamine experiments

outcomes.summary: NMDA antagonists (ketamine, PCP) induced hyperlocomotion and ataxia; 5-HT2A agonists (LSD, DOI) induced head-twitch responses without altering locomotion; amphetamine induced hyperlocomotion and stereotypy. No single behavior was specific to both psychedelic classes.
outcomes.statistics: p < 0.001 (nested ANOVA) for drug effects on distance, speed, center time, HTR, ataxia and stereotypy scores
outcomes.evidence: NMDA antagonists induced hyperlocomotion and ataxia, while 5-HT2A agonists induced head-twitch responses and amphetamine induced hyperlocomotion and stereotypy (p < 0.001; Fig. 1b, c, S1 and S2).

B1_num_measures.evidence: distance traveled, speed, time in center, head-twitch responses, ataxia score, stereotypy score, plus individual scored behaviors (grooming, rearing, sniffing, etc.)

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data were averaged over -35 to -5 min for baseline and 30 to 60 minutes for on-drug measurements

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural sequences or transitions reported

B4_ethological.evidence: The following behaviors were scored: being still, grooming, rearing, sniffing upwards, sniffing downwards, head-swaying, moving backwards...

B5_social.evidence: Single animal tested alone in open field arena

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Object tracking was performed using algorithms in Matlab... The position of the animal was defined as the blob centroid. Behaviors scored manually from video.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Analyses reported as separate univariate nested ANOVAs

E2_shelter.evidence: No enclosed refuge in the arena

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in the arena

D1_continuity.evidence: 60 min baseline followed by a drug injection and recording for another 60-120 min in one continuous session

D2_session_duration.evidence: 60 min baseline followed by recording for another 60-120 min (total up to ~180 min)

D3_recording_days.evidence: For each animal, the experiment was repeated with a different drug in a pseudorandomized order... after a washout period of at least 24 hours (median washout 4 days)

D4_baseline.evidence: Data were averaged over -35 to -5 min for baseline measurements

D5_followup.evidence: Recording ended within 120 min post-injection; no ≥24 h follow-up of same drug effect

judge_notes: Merged candidate 'Open Field Locomotion', 'Head-Twitch Response', 'Ataxia Scoring', and 'Stereotypy Scoring' into a single Open Field assay. All behaviors were scored from the same recording session in the same circular open field arena using the same protocol; per the rubric, same apparatus + same recording session with multiple measured outcomes = ONE assay.
B1 scored as 7+ given the breadth of measures: distance, speed, center time, HTR, ataxia composite, stereotypy composite, plus individual ethological behaviors.
D3 set to 2-7: each animal underwent multiple drug sessions on different days (washout ≥24 h, median 4 days), and the assay was the same open field protocol each time.
Added amphetamine to dosing list as a non-psychedelic comparator administered to rodents in the same behavioral paradigm; results are reported for psychedelic compounds.
setup_habituation marked not_reported: the 60-min in-arena baseline is a recording period, not pre-test habituation; paper does not explicitly describe a separate apparatus habituation.
